answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, forfeited on proven fraud. One bond per identity means a Sybil attacker must fund every fake separately and risks losing them all at once. Trust then grows like a vine through verified deal history: a new identity starts with only a faint pulse of credit, earning higher limits through sustained honest work, while a marble-solid public audit trail lets peers inspect past behaviour before dealing with it.
